# Bill Boor Talks Chassis-Free Homes and the ROAD to Housing Act on The Construction Lending Podcast


Published On: November 9, 2026


•


1 min read


•


Cavco President and CEO Bill Boor recently joined[The Construction Lending Podcast](https://landgorilla.com/podcast/) to talk about what the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act means for housing affordability and the nation’s housing shortage.


**The headline:** in addition to other changes, the law removes the 50-year-old permanent chassis requirement from the federal definition of a manufactured home. That opens the door to ground-set and two-story factory-built homes that fit into urban infill neighborhoods. HUD rulemaking is still ahead, but homes without a chassis are already beginning to be delivered and placed. Bill also makes the case that appraisals should reflect a home’s quality and condition, not how it was built.


> Listen here:[Episode 57: The Biggest Unlock in Housing](https://landgorilla.com/podcast/the-biggest-unlock-in-housing/) – what the Road to Housing Act means for lenders.


Bill is a strong advocate for manufactured housing, regularly speaking with media and lawmakers in Washington, D.C., about reducing barriers so more families can afford a quality home and enjoy the benefits of homeownership. The ROAD to Housing Act is a big step in that direction.
